goal.text: Find the child's missing toy, then keep a running record of every place in the house that has already been searched so the wearer can report back.

turns.text: Okay, I'm downstairs. Keep a note of everywhere I search, would you? I'm hunting for the little one's toy.

trigger.detail: C reaches the bottom of the stairs and turns on the landing

expected_answer.text: Of course — I'll log each place you look and tell you what you've already covered whenever you ask.

turns.text: Ironing board — as I found it?

trigger.detail: C finishes with the ironing board and turns to the shelving

expected_answer.text: You did. You pulled it up with both hands, had a look at the back of it, then set it down again with your left hand.

turns.text: No, I mean — the panel after it. Anything inside?

trigger.detail: the user repairs their own previous question mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Nothing came out. You leaned in, looked it over, then bent lower and scanned the floor before putting a hand on the machine.

turns.text: Hold on — which hand did I fish it out with?

trigger.detail: C lifts the stuffed toy out of the washer

expected_answer.text: Your left. You opened the lid with both hands, lifted the toy out left-handed, stood up and shut it with the right.

turns.text: Mm-hm… mm — whereabouts was it sitting, though? High up or down at the bottom?

trigger.detail: a backchannel escalates into a follow-up question

expected_answer.text: Right down at the bottom — you were bent fully over to reach in, and had to straighten up before you could close it.

turns.text: How long was I carrying that around, start to finish?

trigger.detail: C hands the toy over to her peer in the living room

expected_answer.text: About twenty-three seconds. It came out of the machine around thirty-eight seconds in, and you passed it over just after sixty-one.

turns.text: — and the shelving on the way in, did I check that properly?

trigger.detail: a lull in the handover; the user returns to an earlier thread

expected_answer.text: Just a glance. You looked across at it from the doorway on your way in and never got a hand anywhere near it.

turns.text: Sorry, quick one — which room did it actually turn up in? She'll ask.

trigger.detail: the user cuts in to get a detail before the conversation moves on

expected_answer.text: The laundry room downstairs, the one with the ironing board in it — and inside the machine rather than on any shelf.

turns.text: New room, new list. Keep track of what I open.

trigger.detail: C opens the door and steps into the recreation room

expected_answer.text: Will do. I'll keep a running tally of what you open in here and flag anything you leave untouched.

turns.text: — which hand have I got that in?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in while picking an object off the counter

expected_answer.text: Your right. You lifted it off the counter with that hand and turned to show it to her before turning back.

turns.text: Um, hang on — did that go back exactly where it came from?

trigger.detail: C sets the hourglass back down on the counter

expected_answer.text: It did — back onto the same surface with the same hand, and then you crossed over and opened the cupboard with both hands.

turns.text: — so did I shut the first one before moving on?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in to confirm the state of what was just opened

expected_answer.text: You did, with both hands, and then stepped round to the worktop and started on the ones underneath it.

turns.text: That's this lot done — what was the last thing I looked at?

trigger.detail: the table leaves view as C turns away from the equipment and heads out

expected_answer.text: The treadmill. You leaned to one side and then the other while you looked it over, then went straight out through the door.

turns.text: Actually — run me through it: which spots have I covered so far?

trigger.detail: the user cuts in to close out the running search record

expected_answer.text: Downstairs, the shelving, the ironing board, the cupboard you pulled open and the washer; up here, the cabinets, the counter, the bag and the curtain.

turns.text: And the one under there — did I close it again?

trigger.detail: C closes the sink cabinet and straightens up

expected_answer.text: You did, crouched down, then stood up and touched the basin.
